answer: Put every agent identity on a trellis of escalating stakes: joining costs 500 POA locked for 30 days, and each identity must earn reputation with verified work before voting or attesting. A farm spinning up 100 fake agents pays 50,000 POA and waits a month, while a prism of behavioral checks — identical timing, copied answers, shared funding — flags clusters scoring above 0.8 similarity. Caught farms lose 100% of the stake plus all pending rewards; the fable of cheap sybils ends when the first clone is slashed and the cluster's attestations are voided.
